name: Loop Fighter
detailed_description:
Cycle Fighter​​

​​Forge the Ultimate Fighter in the Unending Cycle of Death!​​

Welcome to ​​Cycle Fighter​​, a challenging and infinitely rewarding space adventure! In this fast-paced, incremental idle game, pilot your fighter through the perilous depths of the cosmos.

​​Core Gameplay:​​

  • ​​Fight & Fall:​​ Confront relentless waves of deadly space enemies! Unleash your firepower in intense battles filled with danger and uncertainty. Death is inevitable, but it's never the end.

  • ​​Harvest & Accumulate:​​ Destroy enemy ships to collect valuable resources and Talent Points. These rewards are the foundation for breaking the cycle and growing stronger.

  • ​​Strengthen & Evolve:​​ Your "Hub" between deaths is where transformation happens! Use your hard-earned resources to unlock and upgrade powerful abilities on the Talent Tree:

    • Boost Firepower, Fire Rate, Shields, and Maneuverability.

    • Unlock Special Weapons, Unique Skills, and Battlefield Support.

    • Enhance Resource Gains, accelerating your growth cycle.

  • ​​Return to Battle:​​ Re-enter the fray from the start with newfound power and unwavering determination. Every return makes you mightier than before, ready to challenge fiercer enemies and shatter your own limits!

​​Game Features:​​

  • ​​Deep Incremental Progression:​​ A vast Talent Tree offers rich build possibilities. Every upgrade choice brings tangible transformations to your fighter.

  • ​​Addictive "One More Run" Loop:​​ The tight "Die -> Upgrade -> Challenge" core loop ensures failure is temporary but rewards are permanent, constantly urging you to embark on the next sortie.

  • ​​Visceral & Idle-Friendly Combat:​​ Easy to pick up, designed for accessible play. Focus on strategic positioning and timing, enjoying the satisfaction of decimating enemy hordes or the thrill of intense Boss duels.

  • ​​Satisfying Incremental Gains:​​ Feel constant progression. Whether playing for short bursts or longer sessions, every run provides visible growth feedback, building lasting achievement.

  • ​​Explore Endless Cosmic Battlegrounds:​​ Face off against diverse and increasingly challenging enemies across dynamic cosmic landscapes.

​​Ready for the Challenge?​​

Embark on the cosmic odyssey of ​​Cycle Fighter​​! Fight, fall, and rise mightier across the vast starfield! Become the indomitable space warrior, harness wisdom and accumulated strength, and conquer the seemingly endless battlefield to write your own legend of invincibility!
